text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear prioritization. Start by listing all your tasks and deciding which ones are most important. Focus on the most urgent work first, and set aside time each day for steady progress. Scope management is also important: if a task is too big, break it into smaller steps, and be realistic about what you can finish. Finally, communicate with your team or manager early. If you see a problem, speak up before it becomes serious. Good communication helps everyone adjust plans and avoid stress. With these habits, you can meet deadlines more calmly and produce better work.
